newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 1,564-1,570 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 1,564-1,570 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,564-1,570 per dollar in lively interbank trade, a touch softer from the morning's 1,560-1,565 due to a rise in foreign currency demand , dealers said.
"Dollar demand increased in the afternoon and the lev eased around five from early levels. Trade was lively as foreign currency supply was relatively large," a bank dealer said.
Traders said the central bank was seen buying dollars near market levels today. Central bank officials were not available for comment.

The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) has been seen as a net dollar buyer in the market for more than a month, aiming to boost its forex reserves ahead of the introduction of a fixed exchange rate mechanism, the currency board.

According to a $510 million funding arrangement between the interim government and the International Monetary Fund signed last month, Bulgaria is to introduce a currency board system in June to restore confidence in the lev.
The system would require levs in circulation to be exactly matched by the BNB foreign exchange reserves. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
